task.notes: Tries K9: fold T3/Gata4->Mab21l2 with the released wild-type series added for the reference's revert.

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

raw.factor: K2a's estimator on the fold's own source against its matched WT (t3_source_frame): strict non-Mesp1 labels, gene_factor (rules.yaml components.factor), exponent 1
raw.build: build_submission.construct and assemble, as K2a; no depth, no composition

raw_half.factor: K2a's estimator on the fold's own source against its matched WT (t3_source_frame): strict non-Mesp1 labels, gene_factor (rules.yaml components.factor), exponent 1
raw_half.build: build_submission.construct and assemble, as K2a; no depth, no composition
raw_half.k14_form: phi_raw applied through t3_decompose.apply_gene_factor (continuing K9's build generator) to a uniformly random floor(n/2) of the n drawn cells, drawn by t3d.stable_rng(build seed, HALF_STREAM); the other cells keep the reference's counts as drawn (try H16's form)

raw_half_ctrl.factor: K2a's estimator on the fold's own source against its matched WT (t3_source_frame): strict non-Mesp1 labels, gene_factor (rules.yaml components.factor), exponent 1
raw_half_ctrl.build: build_submission.construct and assemble, as K2a; no depth, no composition
raw_half_ctrl.k14_form: every drawn cell through K9's raw path with phi_ctrl = (1 + phi_raw) / 2 elementwise (no finalize): it moves each gene's expected count exactly as far as raw_half's mixture does, in every cell, without two kinds of cells in the file

raw_xt.factor: K2a's estimator on the fold's own source against its matched WT (t3_source_frame): strict non-Mesp1 labels, gene_factor (rules.yaml components.factor), exponent 1
raw_xt.build: build_submission.construct and assemble, as K2a; no depth, no composition
raw_xt.k14_form: raw's build, then per cell the total over the moved entries brought to rint of its expected total by try H18's repair (hypergeometric removal over the drawn units, multinomial addition at the expected profile) on t3d.stable_rng(build seed, XT_STREAM)

raw_mn.factor: K2a's estimator on the fold's own source against its matched WT (t3_source_frame): strict non-Mesp1 labels, gene_factor (rules.yaml components.factor), exponent 1
raw_mn.build: build_submission.construct and assemble, as K2a; no depth, no composition
raw_mn.k14_form: raw's build, then per cell the moved entries redrawn as one Multinomial(rint(S), e / S) (try H19's form) on t3d.stable_rng(build seed, MN_STREAM)
